subject: [hw] R1 finding F6 (V03, LOW): n2elf_link is not transactional; a retry re-applies RELATIVE relocations
body:
From the R1 review of DONE V03 rev 3 (loader/test_v03 PASS 12964/12964; n2elf.c and n2elf_reloc.c read; no other V03 finding).

F6 (loader/n2elf.c:811-874): if a relocation fails halfway (unsupported type, bad target, unresolved data import), earlier relocations of the same image have already been written and im->linked remains 0. A second n2elf_link() call re-applies them. R_ARM_RELATIVE reads its addend from the target, so the second pass computes bias + (bias + A) - a wrong guest address. The API does not promise retry and all current callers abort on failure, so this is a robustness note, not a current bug. Suggested fix: mark the image failed (or linked) on the first attempt, e.g. add `int failed;` and refuse a retry with a clear error, or set im->linked = 1 before applying and roll back only the bookkeeping.

Recorded as F6 in gpu/hwcodec/review/r1/FINDINGS.md. The rest of V03 looks solid: relocation targets are bounded to PT_LOAD, the packed/RELR/GNU-hash walks are bounded, and no host pointer reaches guest memory.
